provenance.notes: The replay shows only the first evaluation seed. New architecture and explicit assumptions; no claim of paper-level performance.

config.implementation: maintained-reference-v0.2; not an exact historical reproduction

summary.uncertainty_unit: evaluation episodes of one fixed policy; NOT independent training seeds

metric_definitions.communication: sum-link spectral efficiency, bit/s/Hz; no bandwidth/association model
metric_definitions.sensing_proxy: dimensionless SNR proxy; not CRB or positioning RMSE
metric_definitions.speed_cost: weighted sum of UAV speeds; not energy in joules
metric_definitions.collision_episode: at least one sampled distance below safe_distance; not continuous-time safety
